description: Call this when you want the stored measurements for a host. FREE. Read stored measurements for a host you operate or anyone can read: listing versus quoted price, whether recent unpaid checks returned a valid payment request, payTo observations. Not a judgement. Pass probe:true with session (the verified-owner token from POST /v1/seller/claim/verify) to run one on-demand unpaid probe with the same receipt code as buyer checks. probe is rate-limited.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, e.g. blockrun.ai or https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions

probe.description: Verified owners only. Runs one unpaid probe.

session.description: Owner session token. Required when probe is true.

name: seller_self_check
